findings:

🟡 [t3-writer-fence-gap] MUST-FIX T3 does not exercise the specified malformed writer-fence case: it changes `artifact_reference.base` while leaving `writer_fence` intact, so regressions in writer-fence validation remain undetected; corrupt the writer-fence digest in the copied ledger and retain the expected pre-claim `campaign_resume_candidate_invalid` and zero-call assertions.
